recognize_zh: 低倍視野內白血球明顯增加，以單核球為主，其中有細胞核較圓、染色質較細、胞質灰藍的幼稚單核球／原單核球；旁邊的嗜中性球顆粒稀少、分葉不良，呈現發育不良（dysplasia），這種「單核球增多＋嗜中性球異形」組合提示 CMML。
features: Increased monocytes, several with folded or kidney-shaped nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm
Occasional larger immature forms (promonocytes/monoblasts) with round-oval nuclei, finer chromatin and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm
Neutrophils with hypogranular pale cytoplasm and abnormal/hyposegmented nuclear lobation (dysgranulopoiesis)
No Auer rods or prominent granules in the immature cells
Background red cells without striking abnormality; few platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows leukocytosis with an absolute monocytosis. The monocytes range from mature forms with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm to immature monocytes, and a few larger cells with round to oval nuclei, finer chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm consistent with monoblasts/promonocytes. Several neutrophils are hypogranular with abnormal nuclear segmentation, indicating dysgranulopoiesis. Blasts plus promonocytes appear to be a minority of the nucleated cells in this field, although a formal differential count is required. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are mature without a spectrum of immature forms, and neutrophils lack hypogranularity or pseudo-Pelger changes; persistence >3 months and clonal studies help.
AML requires blasts plus promonocytes ≥20% of blood or marrow cells, whereas CMML has <20% blast equivalents.
CML shows a left-shifted granulocytic series with basophilia and myelocyte bulge rather than monocytosis with dysplasia, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
Atypical CML is dominated by dysplastic neutrophils and circulating immature granulocytes with monocytes <10% of WBC.
